band_verdict: BAND NOT REPRODUCED on draw 2: 0.74 vs 0.9512. The V8 C1 figure is a single-draw point estimate, not a demonstrated band. Two draws show spread, not a confidence interval — no CI claimed from n=2.

campaign_cost.note: Gate-C efficiency at loop scale: ~2.6 s/mutant all-in (lint+sim+fuzz ladder). No LLM spend (deterministic campaign).

methodology_fix.change: run_mutants.load_dispositions(seed): dispositions load ONLY for seed 7; fresh seeds start undispositioned. --seed/--out flags added; seed!=7 uses isolated catalog + partial files (frozen seed-7 artifacts untouched).
methodology_fix.tripwire: Cross-seed false EQUIVALENTs caught by ID-vs-mutation comparison (all 19 seed-7 dispositions mismatched seed-8 mutants) before any conclusion was drawn; seed-8 report recomputed clean.

p0_gate_effect: none — V8 P0 GATE GO stands on the frozen seed-7 campaign; this finding concerns band breadth, not the P0 verdict
prescribed_followup: Per-mutant equivalent-vs-blind-spot triage of the 26 draw-2 survivors (V6-style analysis loop) and any resulting vector/trace hardening — NOT done in P1-03; proposed as follow-up work, not silently dropped.
survivor_characterization: Op-profile matches the known V6 blind-spot families (observability: ADR/master-pin invisibility; stimulus: lane/edge cases) — consistent with the existing gap report, no new failure mode demonstrated. Per-mutant root-causing explicitly out of P1-03 scope.
